content: Is there any conversation ongoing regarding foundations of mathematics? Specifically, objects, properties of the objects, questions about the objects, actions performed on the objects, restrictions on those actions, and motivations for performing the actions

The short answer is yes: there are lots of them on this Zulip alone.

If you mean a universal foundation for all of mathematics, that conversation is also ongoing, but given the breadth of expression of mathematical ideas, it is unlikely that there will be such a foundation. Lean is an attempt to provide a means of expression for many forms of mathematics, and is moderately successful at representing much of existing mathematics, but this is being worked out and it is also unlikely that Lean 4.0 will capture all of current mathematics. For details, look at channels like #**Is there code for X?> and discussions occurring in some of the specific projects.

If you are looking for something more specific (a.k.a. a particular flavor of category theory or set theory or program construction and representation or systems for metaprogramming or some other foundational system), you can check out many of the corresponding channels on this Zulip. A web search can provide more, and artificially intelligent agents can proffer their opinions when asked.
